name: Wandee Clinic ( วันดีคลินิก ฟิลเลอร์ ขอนแก่น )

summary_en: Wandee Clinic in Khon Kaen specializes in plastic surgery and filler treatments, maintaining a 5.0 rating based on 5 total reviews. The clinic has been referenced in 3 Pantip discussions, where users specifically seek recommendations for facial contouring and rhinoplasty procedures in the Khon Kaen area.
